value.sql:
SELECT
  product_key,
  product_name,
  brand,
  category_name,
  sub_category_name
FROM contoso_served.dim_product
value.means: Every product Contoso sells — 2,517 SKUs, one row per product, no filter of any kind applied. This is the whole catalogue spread across 8 top-level categories and 32 sub-categories, and it is the starting population the later steps will narrow. It is NOT narrowed to Electronics, because no such category exists to narrow to.

value.means: Zero products. Not "products worth nothing" and not "a category that sold nothing" — there is no row in the catalogue whose category is Electronics, so this step hands the rest of the walk an empty set. Any revenue figure computed downstream from here would be 0.00 for the sole reason that the filter named a category this warehouse does not have, and reporting that as German Electronics revenue would be a false statement about the business rather than a measurement of it.

readings.could_also_mean: sub_category_name, the 32-member level below it — but this makes no difference here, because 'Electronics' is absent from both, so the level choice cannot change this step's outcome
readings.declaration: product_category.ambiguity.which_level, default: category, never mix the two in one breakdown

blocked.needs: a value of dim_product.category_name equal to 'Electronics'. The column holds exactly eight members and that is not one of them: Audio, Cameras and camcorders, Cell phones, Computers, Games and Toys, Home Appliances, Music Movies and Audio Books, TV and Video. Measured on all 2,517 product rows: 0 match category_name = 'Electronics', and 0 match lower(category_name) LIKE '%electron%' or lower(sub_category_name) LIKE '%electron%' across the 32 sub-categories either, so the member is absent at BOTH declared levels of the hierarchy and switching level under product_category.ambiguity.which_level does not rescue it. What would unblock this: the reader naming which of the eight real categories they count as Electronics. Several are consumer electronics on any ordinary reading (Audio, Cameras and camcorders, Cell phones, Computers, TV and Video), Home Appliances and Games and Toys are arguable, and Music Movies and Audio Books is media rather than hardware — but no declaration in this bundle groups categories into anything wider than category_name, so the membership is the reader's to set and not mine to guess.
